turns.instruction:
Prepare a one-page calculation summary for an 8 m horizontal simply supported beam, with a left pin and right vertical roller. Apply 18 kN/m downward along the entire beam and a +20 kN.m moment about global Y at the right end. Keep the right-end Y rotation free. Report midpoint Z displacement and bending moment, right-end Y rotation and both support reactions. The summary and structured table must agree in sign, units, position and load selection.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
